name: Card Clashes
tagline: Split the deck, flip two cards, and let place value decide who wins the skirmish.

steps.title: Split the deck
steps.text: Shuffle the number cards and deal them all out face-down. Nobody looks at their pile.

steps.title: Flip and build
steps.text: On “clash”, every player flips their top card and lays it in the shared frame — decide together whether today's clash is for the biggest or smallest number.

steps.title: Read it aloud
steps.text: Each player reads their full number out loud, place by place — “four thousand, two hundred and five” beats a mumbled “forty-two-five”.

steps.title: Take the pot
steps.text: The winning number takes every card on the table and adds them to a score pile. A tie means war: flip two more cards each and compare again.

steps.title: Estimate twists
steps.text: In advanced rounds, cards are multiplied by a target factor — estimate first, then calculate. Closest estimate takes the pot.

steps.title: End the game
steps.text: The game ends when one player holds all the cards, or after ten rounds — highest score pile wins.

challenges.title: Perfect Order
challenges.brief: Win a clash, then immediately arrange the four captured cards from smallest to largest — all in under 30 seconds.

challenges.title: Decimal Duel
challenges.brief: Win three consecutive clashes where the numbers differ only after the decimal point.

challenges.title: Estimator's Eye
challenges.brief: Call an estimate within 5% of the true product in a multiplication twist round — twice in a row.

scorecard.scoring: 1 point per round won, plus the printed points for each challenge completed. Deduct 2 points for any misread place value.
